observable.name: Pantheon+ distance-modulus anisotropy in first-order directional Hubble modes
observable.law: delta ln d_L = -[sigma_nn - A.n/c]/Hbar (z-independent) + Doppler/bulk-flow term ~ beta.n/z; delta mu = (5/ln10) delta ln d_L
observable.sign_convention: n = line of sight observer->source; acceleration enters with +A.n/c in delta ln d_L (H(n) = Theta/3 + sigma_nn - A.n/c)
observable.congruence: observer congruence = source congruence (comoving) at this order; differences carried as the Doppler/flow term
observable.stf_chart: Frobenius-orthonormal STF basis (declared); Cartesian-5 results must use G_STF5
observable.ratio_vs_difference: amplitudes are R = DeltaH/Hbar (dimensionless); Hbar is a free monopole because partial-sky mean != Theta/3

parameters: optional Flow_1..3 (bulk flow, same 1/z shape as Dop => degenerate)
isotropic z-dependence (q0-like, j0-like) as free monopole nuisance

data_binding.row_identity: COUNT ONLY: dat rows == cov dimension; the files carry no per-row ID in the covariance, so the row-to-row mapping is assumed from release convention and NOT independently verified

covariance_checks.spd: Cholesky succeeded for every subsample used

data_binding.selection: Hubble-flow subsample IS_CALIBRATOR == 0 with a stated zHD cut (0.010 / 0.023 / 0.050); calibrators are excluded from any anisotropy fit
data_binding.desi: compressed BAO vector = background control only; no angular estimator

structural_identifiability_formal_sd.units: sigma_STF/Hbar and A/(c Hbar) dimensionless; Dop in units of beta; statistical + Pantheon+ systematic covariance only, first-order model, no second-order or peculiar-velocity-covariance terms
structural_identifiability_formal_sd.rank_with_bulk_flow_nuisance: 12 of 15 in every case; null space exactly the Dop/Flow pair (nullity 3)
structural_identifiability_formal_sd.quadrupole_acceleration_leakage: max posterior correlation Adip-Q 0.54-0.74; dropping the acceleration dipole shrinks Q sd by 5-25%

unavailable: per-row ID verification of the covariance order
calibration/M-H0 treatment beyond a free offset
fit to real distances (deliberately not run)
